question: **Pick out the wrongly spelt word from the given words.**
solution:
The erroneous spelling is '**Germent**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• 
 Out of all the options, the word '**Germent**' is wrong.
 
 
• 
 The correct spelling is '**Garment**'.
 
 
• 
 The meaning of 'Garment' is 'One piece of clothing'. *(**कपड़े का एक टुकड़ाI)*

 
 
• 
 For example, *Many of the garments have the customers' name tags sewn into the linings.*
 
 
 
 
• 
 Therefore, the correct option is 3.
